en.El aviso se presenta conforme a la Ley N: This notice is provided in accordance with Law No. 8968, Protection of Individuals with Regard to the Processing of Their Personal Data, and explains the purposes, use, and people who may access the information.
en.Responsable declarado para esta demostra: Controller stated for this demonstration: TheFunGang Group, an academic project at the Costa Rica Institute of Technology. Institutional address for reference: Central Cartago Technological Campus, Cartago, Calle 15, Avenida 14, 1 km south of the Basilica of Our Lady of the Angels.
en.PricePeek mantiene bases de datos de cue: PricePeek maintains databases of accounts, wishlists, alerts, reviews, and reports to operate the application. This page and the consent are presented separately from other agreements.
en.Para registrar y proteger su cuenta trat: To register and protect your account, we process your name, email address, and password (stored securely). We use your name to identify your profile within your account; your email is used to sign in, recover or change your password, and send alerts you enable.
en.También registramos fechas de acceso y c: We also record login and password change dates to protect the account and keep it working.
en.Si usted usa esas funciones, también tra: If you use these features, we also process saved products, target prices, selected stores, alert settings, reviews, ratings, optional photos, and reports. This data lets us provide requested features, maintain security, and moderate content.
en.El nombre, correo, contraseña y aceptaci: Your name, email, password, and acceptance of this policy are required to create an account. The wishlist, alerts, reviews, and photos are optional. You can disable alerts in your profile.
en.El equipo autorizado del proyecto puede: Authorized project team members may access data to operate the application and moderate reviews. Technical providers that host the database, send email, or store photos may process the data needed for those tasks. We do not sell personal data or share it with stores for advertising.
en.Las reseñas, calificaciones y fotos que: Reviews, ratings, and photos you post may be publicly displayed. The application does not show your email or publicly link your account name to a review; the content you write or photograph could identify you, so avoid including personal information you do not want to disclose.
en.Usamos cookies técnicas de sesión y prot: We use technical session and cross-site request forgery protection cookies to sign in and protect forms. Your light or dark theme preference is saved in your browser. We do not use advertising cookies or record anonymous product views.
en.Conservamos los datos mientras la cuenta: We retain data while your account is active and the data is needed for the stated purposes. When you delete your account, we delete your profile data, wishlist, reviews, and associated photos. We keep a minimal record of the consent version and dates of consent and withdrawal, without linking it to an identifiable account.
en.Aplicamos controles de acceso, protecció: We apply access controls, password protection, secure database connections, and technical measures to reduce the risk of unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. No system can guarantee absolute security.
en.Sus derechos y cómo ejercerlos: Your Rights and How to Exercise Them
en.Usted puede consultar y actualizar su no: You can view and update your name and email in your profile and download a copy of your account data. You can also edit or delete your reviews and request deletion of your account. Deleting your account withdraws consent for processing associated with the service and stops features that depend on it.
en.Eliminar mi cuenta o retirar el consenti: Delete my account or withdraw consent
en.Para acceder, actualizar o eliminar los: To access, update, or delete account data, sign in and use the profile and account deletion options.
en.Si cambia la finalidad o el uso de los d: If the purpose or use of data changes, PricePeek will update this policy and request new consent when required. The current version and date appear at the top of this page.
en.PricePeek es un proyecto universitario d: PricePeek is a university demonstration project. Before using it as a real service, confirm the legally responsible individual or legal entity and verify the practices of hosting, email, and storage providers.
en.Sin su consentimiento no podemos crear u: Without your consent, we cannot create an account for you, but you can browse the public catalog without registering.
en.Actualizamos el aviso de privacidad. Par: We updated the privacy notice. To continue using your account, review the policy and give your express consent.
en.100% Imparcial. No vendemos productos, n: 100% impartial. We do not sell products, we do not charge commissions, and no store pays to appear first. Our only customer is the Costa Rican consumer.
